answer: A polling station presiding officer record is the credential: elections run at one station across years of counts. Each of 532 aliases needs its own authority-backed record, and the live check behind each one makes bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The karst test is the price tag: 532 fakes mean 532 payments. The registry is consulted again every epoch, and a record that does not match the issuer's own books ends the seat. The inlet signal is visible to every grader, and the shale ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
